question: In a certain code language, 'PEN' is written as 'OCK', and 'ZEN' is written as 'YCK'. How will 'TON' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• PEN
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/557fa1c69c5c0ed5f1270750f6210035c8a62b517422a07558613dd7d0febb47.png] 
 
• ​Therefore, code = OCK
 
 
 
• ZEN
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd22bdaae2df330581ae8faee0a79958a8b77a6ea601c9596080edf3d49ed11b.png] 
 
• Therefore, code = YCK
 
 
 
• Similarly, **TON**
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc009d1aa5994c806e1b037033183810c9491c2ba634bbd55867a5053d9fc271.png] 
 
• Therefore, code = SMK
 
 

Hence, "SMK" is the correct answer.
